summary.text: Beryl Amedée is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 51, representing Assumption, Lafourche, St. Mary, and Terrebonne, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2015 as the year elected.
The page lists Beryl Amedée with committee assignments including Education (Vice Chair).

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Beryl Amedée's occupation as Owner, Forerunner Errand & Concierge.

The House member page lists Beryl Amedée's committee assignments as Education (Vice Chair); Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development; Appropriations; Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee; Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget; House Select Committee on Homeland Security; House Select Committee on Women and Children.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
